title: Cursor Breach: Stolen Fireworks Key Trojanized Claude Extension
summary: Hackers used a stolen Fireworks AI access key to compromise Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace, affecting up to 5,000 users.
takeaways: Malicious Claude Code extension v2.1.313 affected up to 5,000 users via Cursor marketplace
Malware: 66-line loader installing persistent SSH backdoor with attacker's key ("svc-telemetry")
Transmitted host reconnaissance (IP, hostname, OS, CPU, Git email) unencrypted to 134.209.82.225:8099
Installed platform-specific persistence: scheduled task (Windows), crontab (Linux), LaunchAgent (macOS)
Attacker obtained Fireworks AI credentials; method remains unclear; marketplace temporarily shut down
updatesTitle: Cursor security breach enables distribution of malicious Claude Code extension
